setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Start with channel 1 routed to the generic CC Device, pattern 1 playing four trigs on steps 1–4, and CC 1 assigned to Trig params slot 1 at channel value 63. The example uses 90 BPM and Rate /24, giving four seconds per channel step so there is time to edit while recording. Tap Record (2,8): its grid cell blinks and slot 1 still reads 63. Start playback and turn E3 to 64; the new value records on following eligible steps. Disarm Record and stop before inspecting step 2.

assertion.characterisation: The captured armed blink phase is grid level 12; the renderer test marks its blink output as -4.
The captured armed blink phase is grid level 12; the renderer test marks its blink output as -4.

steps.title: Arm parameter recording

steps.caption: After disarming and stopping playback, hold step 2 at (2,4). Trig Params shows CC 1 at 64 with an L marker: the edited value was stored as a lock on that step.

assertion.characterisation: Current Trig Params screen marks the recorded step value with L.

steps.title: See the recorded value on step 2
